build_informed_sender: build an InformedSender neural network module for signal game sender with configurable game size and vocab size
build_receiver: build a Receiver neural network module for signal game receiver with reinforce or non-reinforce mode
run_informed_sender_forward: run the InformedSender forward pass to produce log-softmax logits over vocab from game features
run_receiver_forward: run the Receiver forward pass to produce log-softmax probabilities over game items from a signal
review_informed_sender_return_embeddings: review the InformedSender return_embeddings method that embeds and concatenates per-item feature vectors
